Author: phys1ks
Name: PuppetMasterKK
Punchline: Let others tell you what to do.
Description: Trusted chat messages make your character emote or run commands you allow. Friends can make you follow them, walk over to them with vnavmesh, or copy their emotes, and emotes aimed at you get answered in kind. Every trigger chooses who can set it off, which channels it listens to, and which commands it may run, with protections for chat, risky game commands and other plugins' commands switched on by default.
